summary: Phase 2 feature testing for LakeBridge SaaS landing page. All major features verified: dark theme default, theme toggle (navbar + docs), waitlist form frontend-only (no API calls), /docs route with sidebar/architecture/quickstart sections, /blog route, SEO meta tags, vercel.json SPA routing.

ui_bugs.issue: Invalid email custom error (data-testid='waitlist-error-message') is unreachable via normal user interaction because the browser's native type='email' validation intercepts before the React handler runs. The custom error state/message code is dead code in practice.
data-testid for 'Use Cases' nav link has a space: 'nav-link-use cases' — inconsistent with other links that use lowercase labels. Should be 'nav-link-use-cases' for consistency.

action_items: Optional: Remove type='email' from waitlist input OR remove custom email validation since they conflict. If custom error message is desired, change input type to 'text' and rely solely on JS regex validation.
Optional: Fix nav-link data-testid for 'Use Cases' to use a dash: nav-link-use-cases
critical_code_review_comments: WaitlistSection: input has both type='email' (browser-native validation) and a custom JS regex validator. Browser intercepts first, so the custom error state/UI (waitlist-error-message) is never shown to users. Either use type='text' + JS validation or drop the redundant JS check.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase 2 features all working: dark theme default, theme toggle (navbar+docs pages), waitlist frontend-only success flow, /docs (sidebar, architecture, quickstart sections), /blog route, SEO og:title + twitter:card meta tags all present, vercel.json rewrite rules present. Minor: invalid email error message unreachable due to browser type='email' validation conflict with custom JS validation.
